exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́вести — to take out, to lead out, to bring out, to move out; to help out (help someone to get off); перевести́ — to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; приводи́ть — to bring (someone with); перево́д — transfer, transference.
